Bolt Diameter d (in.): Notes and Footnotes (ANSI/AISC 360-22 Tables J3.3, J3.4, J3.5 & Sections J3.3–J3.5):
1. When the slot axis is parallel to the edge of the connected part, the edge distance increment C2 = 0 in. (per Table J3.5).

2. Maximum Edge Distance (Sec. J3.5): The maximum distance from the center of any bolt to the nearest edge of parts in contact shall be 12 * t (where t is thickness of connected part under consideration), but shall not exceed 6 in.

3. Maximum Longitudinal Spacing (Sec. J3.5): For painted or unpainted members not subject to corrosion, max spacing = min(24*t, 12 in.). For weathering steel subject to atmospheric corrosion, max spacing = min(14*t, 7 in.).

4. Net Section Hole Deduction (Sec. B4.3b): When computing net area A_n for tension rupture, the effective hole width = d_hole + 1/16 in. (i.e., d + 1/8 in. for standard holes up to 7/8 in. bolt, and d + 3/16 in. for 1 in. and larger bolts).
